# Áurea 1618 — Florals & Decor

> Áurea 1618 is a floral and decoration studio based in Guadalajara, Jalisco, México, led by MEDF. Thelma Vergara, CEO, founder and creative director. The studio designs botanical architecture for destination weddings and private events — large-format floral installations, spatial scenography, bridal bouquets and made-to-order arrangements — composed under the Áurea 1618 proportion (the golden ratio).

Key facts:
- Founder, CEO & creative director: MEDF. Thelma Vergara
- Atelier: Guadalajara, Jalisco, México
- Experience: 20 years, 410 weddings, 19 destinations
- Professional training: Instituto Savia Bruta · Madrid Flower School · MA in Protocol, Event Organisation & Design (Universidad Camilo José Cela) · Intrigue Teaches, Denton, Maryland
- Destinations: Tulum, Cancún, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Vallarta, Punta de Mita, Chapala, Ajijic, Tequila, Mazamitla, San Miguel de Allende, Guadalajara, Guanajuato, Ciudad de México, Mérida, Los Angeles, San Diego, Chicago, Paris, Versailles
- Services: spatial decoration and large-format botanical installations, wedding florals, bridal bouquets, made-to-order arrangements with delivery in Guadalajara
- Contact: luxuryandblush@gmail.com · WhatsApp +52 33 3968 6925
- Wedding planning & direction by Luxury and Blush Events
